scope: Verify that the GTK2 scrollbar arrow recipe follows the dark Breeze KDE color scheme through a real isolated GTK2 2.24.33 preview, including normal, held and released rendering for each direction.

runtime.isolated_test: tools/theme-lab/tests/test_gtk2_public_native.py via a focused runner in ~/tempia; private Xvfb and bwrap/user/network namespace; generated GTK2 RC/assets; no personal home or system bus exposed

comparison.assertion: For all four 15×15 direction cells, hover and released GTK2 pixels equal the generated normal asset (0/225 RGB differences), held pixels equal the generated pressed asset (0/225), held changes 53 pixels, release restores 0 differences.

result.status: passed for isolated BreezeDark GTK2 rendering

limits: This verifies the generated GTK2 recipe in one isolated GTK2 runtime and a dark KDE scheme. It does not prove live desktop-wide scheme switching, installed XChat in-memory styling, or historical VUE held-arrow fidelity.
Horizontal held appearance in the SR10.4 VM remains unverified; current local MAME guard sees a second separately owned MAME instance and blocks graphical input.
